modes.label: white gallery product
modes.prop_policy: no decorative props; only a clean gallery surface and subtle contact shadow
composition_templates: centered three-quarter product view with clean silhouette and subtle grounding shadow
slightly off-center product on pale gray-white field with one quiet diagonal shadow
support_physics: product rests naturally on a clean opaque surface
all wearable structure and support/gallery construction remain visible
lighting_camera: large softbox reflection, crisp metal edge highlights, controlled gemstone sparkle
85mm product lens, f/8-like clarity, no dramatic poster lighting

modes.label: botanical negative space
modes.product_scale: small to medium but highest sharpness
modes.prop_policy: one flower, petal, leaf, or stem creates the quiet field; no bouquet clutter
composition_templates: large cropped flower enters from left edge, pendant or ring sits in the lower right product zone, upper right remains calm empty field
single translucent petal fills the lower third as a soft stage, jewelry placed off-center above its fold, top half left quiet
one stem or leaf draws a diagonal from lower left to upper right, jewelry attached near one intersection point
support_physics: flower or petal touches only the back edge, chain back, or ring underside
hero stones, prongs, shank, pendant face, and earring drops remain unobscured
lighting_camera: soft botanical diffusion with crisp jewelry focus
macro product lens, shallow background falloff, flower texture lower contrast than jewelry

modes.label: botanical support still life
modes.product_scale: medium product with visible support contact
modes.prop_policy: flower, branch, shell, or vase acts as a cradle, rail, hook, or frame
composition_templates: ring or earring pair held by a single branch fork entering from the upper right, quiet matte background behind
pendant chain drops through the throat of one calla lily, pendant face hanging clear below the petal edge
bracelet lightly hooked over a curved stem, product placed on lower third with open background above
support_physics: show believable contact point: hook, fold, fork, lip, or petal throat
support may cover only chain back, earring post back, or ring underside
lighting_camera: editorial still-life light with clean cast shadow
medium macro lens, controlled highlights on metal and stones, props softly modeled

modes.label: asymmetric suspended display
modes.product_scale: medium, with clear continuity and gravity
modes.prop_policy: chain, bracelet, ring, or earring is draped, hung, threaded, or lightly suspended from one quiet support prop
composition_templates: chain enters from top edge on two uneven verticals, pendant placed below center-right, left side remains quiet
bracelet arcs from lower left to upper right, one end sharp and one end softly receding, product face at right third
earring pair hangs at different heights from a pale sculptural lip, lower third open for shadow and breath
support_physics: gravity direction is clear and chain continuity is unbroken
contact points are visible and do not hide clasps, bails, or settings
lighting_camera: clean directional light with precise chain sparkle and believable hanging shadows
85-100mm product lens, shallow background only, product face crisp

modes.label: silk suspension display
modes.product_scale: medium product led by flowing textile line
modes.prop_policy: one translucent silk, organza, or ribbon creates movement and suspension without veiling the jewelry
composition_templates: translucent silk ribbon twists from top left to bottom right, pendant resting visually in the lower curve, open pale background
ring or bracelet lightly cinches a flowing silk fold, jewelry face on the right third, fabric trailing softly behind
necklace chain follows a soft fabric S-curve, pendant hangs clear at the central lower third
support_physics: fabric supports from behind or beneath, never over the hero stone
fold tension and gravity make the suspension believable
lighting_camera: backlit translucent fabric with crisp jewelry edge highlights
soft high-key studio light, shallow depth on textile, sharp product plane

modes.label: editorial still life
modes.product_scale: medium to large product on a controlled stage
modes.prop_policy: stone, frosted glass, shell, wood, paper, or textile provides one quiet surface
composition_templates: product on frosted glass plinth with one diagonal shadow and calm background
ring or earrings on carved stone slab, product placed off-center with visible contact shadow
jewelry nested in a shell or paper fold, support texture lower contrast than stones
support_physics: product rests or leans with clear contact shadow
props never hide main stone, shank, clasp, bail, or earring attachment
lighting_camera: premium still-life studio light with polished reflections and clean shadows
product lens, high clarity on settings and gemstone facets

modes.label: hand wearing product macro
modes.product_scale: wearable scale, jewelry dominant in focus
modes.prop_policy: natural hand only; optional neutral textile background
composition_templates: elegant hand at three-quarter angle, ring on finger in sharp focus, background softly recedes
bracelet on wrist with relaxed pose, product face centered on wrist curve, neutral negative space around
earring near ear or held between fingers only when anatomy remains natural and product is clear
support_physics: wearing logic must be anatomically plausible
fingers, nails, and skin must not deform or hide key product details
lighting_camera: soft beauty product lighting, natural skin tone, crisp jewelry highlights
macro portrait-product lens, shallow background, jewelry plane sharp

modes.label: craft macro
modes.prop_policy: no decorative props; surface or shadow only
composition_templates: close macro of prongs, bezel, stone grain, and metal transitions with one clean shadow
angled craft closeup showing gemstone depth, gallery support, and polished metal edge
detail crop on carving, pavé, enamel, or jade edge translucency with product structure intact
support_physics: support/gallery, prongs, bezels, or joints must be structurally plausible
crop must not remove the logic of the setting
lighting_camera: controlled macro light with precise sparkle and metal reflections
100mm macro, crisp craft plane, background falloff
